title: Howard Hughes and the 'Mormon mafia'

tellings.quote: deeply connected to the Mormon church. The Mormon church kind of like the uh his like senior managers and handlers for all of his his corporate apparatus were essentially Mormon. Um they call him the Mormon mafia, right?

plain: The billionaire Howard Hughes, the analyst Matthew Pines tells Michels, was deeply tied to the Mormon church: the senior managers and handlers who ran his business empire were mostly Mormon, a group people called "the Mormon mafia". Pines says this without naming a source. He brings it up as part of a wider idea that private aerospace companies and the people around them may hold hidden knowledge.
